sources.author: Dutch applications
patch_list: Prevents NOS/NPO analytics initialization, audience events, queued measurement uploads and tracking identifier creation. Uses the app's native empty tracker while preserving content, favourites, sharing and refresh.
Stops the recurring NOS-app promotion on the scoreboard page. Preserves Teletekst pages, favourites, sharing and refresh.
